messages:
Rita: Heads-up  Cascade prospect asked for a perf run tomorrow 09:30 PT. They want to validate steady-state + microburst behavior: 900 sustained qps with intermittent microbursts to 9k qps for 30s every 10m. Mix: 50% chat (ctx ~768 tokens), 40% embeddings (batched), 10% rerank. SLA asks: chat p95 < 180ms, p99 < 500ms; rerank p95 < 120ms. They require customer CMK envelope encryption for embeds and audit logs. Need a concise run plan, ops config snippet for Dedicated, and a quick cost delta. Can @Caleb own harness and @Jun provision infra?

Caleb: I can run the harness. Proposed phases: 1) smoke (5m @50 qps), 2) ramp (15m to 900 qps), 3) soak (30m steady with microburst schedule: 30s bursts to 9k qps every 10m), 4) cooldown (5m). Capture p50/p95/p99 for each phase and for microburst windows, queue depth, embed batch sizes, and span traces. I'll tag run cascade-6260000000. Quick load config snippet I'll use in the harness:
```json
{"target_qps":900,"microburst":{"peak_qps":9000,"duration_secs":30,"every_secs":600},"ramp_minutes":15,"soak_minutes":30,"mix":[{"type":"chat","pct":50,"ctx":768},{"type":"embed","pct":40,"batch_max":32},{"type":"rerank","pct":10}],"metrics":["p50","p95","p99","queue_depth","embed_tps"]}
```

Jun: Infra note: Dedicated pool in us-west-2 pinned for POC. Microbursts need prewarmed burst capacity or immediate overflow policy. Recommend reserved baseline to cover steady-state + prewarm pool of GPU equivalents for burst (or use burst capacity with guaranteed min nodes). KMS: will deploy KMS-proxy in the POC VPC so unwrap latency stays bounded; need a signed addendum and CMK ARN.

Marta: Cost sketch: microburst pattern changes sizing a lot. Rough placeholder: baseline 4 A100-equivalents for steady + 6 hot GPUs for burst headroom (prewarmed) -> coarse delta estimate ~ +N% over steady-only. I'll run model-specific numbers after you pick model/quant. For quoting, recommend Dedicated reserved baseline + short-duration burst pricing line item.

Caleb: Ops tuning for the run: model_batch_size=14 for chat, token_budget_ms=160, kv_cache_ttl=8h, prefix_cache_enabled=true, embed_batch_max=32, rerank_pool_workers=6. Tracing: enable full spans for the microburst windows. Fallback policy: if queue_depth > 300ms during burst, automatically route rerank to a lightweight rerank-quant and divert embed requests to quantized-embed-v1. Set request_timeout=30s and retry=1.

Rita: Good. @Caleb schedule 09:30 PT tomorrow and label run "cascade-6260000000". @Jun please drop the short KMS checklist we can send the customer. @Marta please post the preliminary cost delta by EOD.

ops-bot: Run queued by Caleb  id: br-6260000000, start_time: 2026-07-08T16:30:00Z, phases: smoke/ramp/soak/cooldown, microburst pattern included.

Jun: KMS checklist (short): 1) Confirm CMK ARN & ownership; 2) Signed KMS addendum; 3) Allowlist KMS-proxy endpoint; 4) Provide test unwrap report; 5) Confirm audit log retention needs. Will DM legal template.

Caleb: Harness queued and smoke validated. I'll collect p50/p95/p99 and a short ops action list after soak and call out any p99 spike correlations to KMS/HSM if observed.

Marta: Will post a 2-line cost delta by 18:00 PT.

Rita: Thanks team. Keep everything under NDA and mark any policy blockers. :thumbsup:
